items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-10-21
items.q: I, I think it was one or two lessons. And in my spare time, a man was called Professor Delmo.

ctx.x: at some stage, uh, uh, there's something from Bill Russell, he said that he thought you had learned to read at some stage. Is that true? Uh, no, I never learned to read.
I, I think it was one or two lessons. And in my spare time, a man was called Professor Delmo. Professor who? Delmo, Delmo. Uh, I went there twice. Was this when you were young?
